SELECT MAX(block_date) as max_block_date
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
WHERE block_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

SELECT
  block_date,
  receipt_receiver_account_id AS wallet,
  SUM(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(args, '$.deposit') AS NUMERIC)) / 1e24 AS amt_near
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.recei
